observed_learning.scope: Eight attempts in specified toy models; structural and dense parameterizations differ, so no performance ranking or general convergence claim.

refusal_interpretation: All 21 training refusals pass the registered BIT diagnostic but fail selected exact ALG after endpoint quantization; they are not counted as D corruption or accepted progress.

independent_verification.method: Direct constraints/minors and independent exact IEEE word rounding; independent reconstruction of optimizer proposals, endpoints, losses and state.

reproduction.scope: Same environment and dependency tree; no clean-room or cross-platform claim.

arithmetic.exact: Q with real-space proofs where declared
arithmetic.optimizer: Rational SGD/momentum and separately specified host binary64 AdamW; Python pow/math.sqrt has no universal cross-platform rounding certification.
arithmetic.BF16: Software RNE with gradual underflow and canonical arithmetic zero
arithmetic.FP32: Actually executed local NumPy float32 scalar path audited against exact rational RNE
arithmetic.endpoint_quantization: Exact rational sum rounded once; not a native BF16 optimizer implementation
